column1: # Damage effects of the game, by tag id: what each one belongs to and how much it deals.
# CREDIT. This table is taken from libfilmshell (OpenSpartan, https://github.com/OpenSpartan/libfilmshell,
# MIT licence, copyright (c) 2026 OpenSpartan; licence text in LICENSE-libfilmshell next to this file), file
# `src/game/damage_data.rs`, commit ad17521 ("Generated from the game's files" in that file's own header).
# The maintainers of libfilmshell derived it from the game's damage-effect tags; this module did not read
# WHAT IS TAKEN. For each of the 468 damage effects of that file: its tag id, what it belongs to (`cause`)
# and, for the 411 that deal damage, its numbers: the lower bound, the minimum and maximum of the upper bound
# (points of damage), the multipliers of the Spartan's shield and body, the flags as the tag stores them and
# the radius of its area in engine units.
# WHAT IS TRANSFORMED. One tab-separated line per effect, the tag in hexadecimal on eight digits, the cause in
# `unknown`), the flags in hexadecimal. The weapon owner and the projectile lists of the source are not kept.
# The table is regenerated from libfilmshell, not edited by hand.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated): tag, cause, lower, upper minimum, upper maximum, shield multiplier, body multiplier,
